svg.aria-label: The ZettelFlow Reader: your Library shelf on the left, a book open as a two-page spread, a sentence highlighted, a question written in the margin with the pen, the thought landing in Think, notes from your vault Alongside the page, and Listen reading the chapter aloud.
svg.title: The Reader and the Library

svg.text: A note you never return to is a note

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: you only kept. The shelf remembers

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: where you stopped, but it cannot

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: So the margin matters more than the

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: page. What you mark is a question you

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: asked the author; what you write

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: beside it is the beginning of an

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Reading slowly is not reading less.

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Each chapter is a set of claims, and a

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: claim is only yours once you can say it

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: back in your own words — without

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: That is why the book stops at the end

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: of a chapter and asks what survived:

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: not to test you, but to give the one

text.font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: idea worth keeping a note of its own.
